item.description:
**One Lock Screen card per Mac.** Each Mac now updates only its own Séance card on your iPhone, so two Macs no longer overwrite each other's card, and a Mac whose chats have finished no longer ends the other's.
**No more stacked cards.** When every chat on a Mac finishes, its card says "All done" for 20 minutes and is reused if work starts again, instead of being ended and replaced. While chats work, the card is refreshed every 20 minutes so it never shows as out of date.
**The running timer.** Séance now tells your phone when each chat started working, so the card can show the longest-running chat on a live timer.
